name: Rage Against the Machine

whyMatters.en: Los Angeles four-piece formed in 1991. Combined rap cadence with hard-rock and funk riffs; the 1992 debut put political slogan lyrics on mainstream rock radio and MTV.
whyMatters.zh: 洛杉矶四人组，1991 年成立。把 rap 腔调与 hard-rock、funk riff 合在一起；1992 年同名首专把政治口号歌词送上主流摇滚电台与 MTV。

lyricQuotes: Fuck you, I won't do what you tell me
Weapons not food, not homes, not shoes / Not need, just feed the war cannibal animal

shortBio.en: de la Rocha / Morello four-piece; Killing in the Name is the 1992 citation track.
shortBio.zh: de la Rocha / Morello 四人组；Killing in the Name 是 1992 年引用曲。

body.en:
Formed in 1991 in Los Angeles. The debut and Evil Empire pair de la Rocha’s metered shout with Morello’s effects-led solos, Commerford’s funk bass, and Wilk’s dry drums—DJ-like textures without a sampler.

Killing in the Name (1992) is the main citation track. The band sat at the 1990s overlap of metal radio and protest lyric, before later nu-metal’s pop polish.

Morello put the four together in 1991: Zack de la Rocha, Tim Commerford, and Brad Wilk, who had auditioned for Morello’s earlier band Lock Up. The 1992 debut put Killing in the Name, Bullet in the Head, Know Your Enemy, and Wake Up on MTV and rock radio. The entry sets that record beside Nirvana. Evil Empire, The Battle of Los Angeles, and the covers set Renegades followed. The book says none of them passed the debut.

From the 2000 pause until the 2007 return, Morello, Wilk, and Commerford made three US top-10 albums with Chris Cornell as Audioslave. A 2009 Facebook campaign sent Killing in the Name to the UK Christmas #1. They played a free London show the next summer.
body.zh:
1991 年于洛杉矶组建。首专与 Evil Empire 把 de la Rocha 按拍喊唱、Morello 效果器主导独奏、Commerford funk 贝斯与 Wilk 干鼓配在一起——类似 DJ 的质感，但无采样器。

Killing in the Name（1992）是主要引用曲。乐队位于 1990 年代金属电台与抗议歌词的交汇处，早于后期 nu-metal 的流行抛光。

Morello 1991 年把四人凑齐：Zack de la Rocha、Tim Commerford，以及曾参加 Morello 前乐队 Lock Up 面试的 Brad Wilk。1992 年同名专辑让《Killing in the Name》《Bullet in the Head》《Know Your Enemy》《Wake Up》进了 MTV 和摇滚电台。条目把这张唱片放在 Nirvana 旁边。后面是《Evil Empire》《The Battle of Los Angeles》和翻唱集《Renegades》。书中写它们都没有超过首张。

2000 年停摆到 2007 年回归之间，Morello、Wilk、Commerford 与 Chris Cornell 以 Audioslave 做了三张美国榜前 10 专辑。2009 年一场 Facebook 行动让《Killing in the Name》成为英国圣诞节冠军单曲。次年夏天他们在伦敦办了一场免费演出。

note.en: Dry funk riff and shouted refrain; no samples, full-band arrangement.
note.zh: 干 funk riff 与喊叫副歌；无采样，全乐队编制。

note.en: Morello wah as lead voice; Commerford octave bass on the Evil Empire cycle.
note.zh: Morello 用 wah 作主声部；Evil Empire 周期里 Commerford 八度贝斯。

note.en: From The Battle of Los Angeles; tight verse-chorus, no nu-metal gloss.
note.zh: 出自 The Battle of Los Angeles；紧凑主副歌，无 nu-metal 抛光。

title.zh: Hard-rock riff 上的 rap 腔调

body.en:
The 1992 debut fixes a four-piece writing method: de la Rocha shouts in meter, Morello uses whammy and kill switch as lead voice, Commerford’s funk bass fills the low end.

Killing in the Name and Bulls on Parade put protest lyric on MTV without hip-hop backing tracks.
body.zh:
1992 首专固定四人写法：de la Rocha 按拍喊唱，Morello 把 whammy 与 kill switch 当主声部，Commerford funk 贝斯填满低频。

Killing in the Name 与 Bulls on Parade 把抗议歌词送上 MTV，无需 hip-hop 伴奏轨。

body.en:
de la Rocha, Morello, Commerford, and Wilk are the only lineup the catalog cites. Vocal absences (2000–2007) split the timeline; Audioslave is Morello, Commerford, and Wilk with Chris Cornell—a parallel project.

Peak citation remains the original four on the 1992–99 album run.
body.zh:
de la Rocha、Morello、Commerford、Wilk 是目录唯一引用的阵容。人声缺席（2000–2007）切开时间线；Audioslave 是 Morello、Commerford、Wilk 加 Chris Cornell——平行项目。

引用峰值仍是 1992–99 专辑周期的原四人组。

body.en:
Linkin Park later used verse-rap / chorus-sing splits with DJ beds and pop hooks. Tool shared political-metal festival audiences with RATM in the 1990s.

Morello’s effect-chain solos are widely copied; later bands often take the guitar method more than the slogans.

Audioslave is the shared project with Soundgarden’s singer. The 2010 free London show answers the 2009 UK Christmas #1.
body.zh:
Linkin Park 后来使用 rap 主歌 / 唱副歌分工，并加入 DJ 铺底与 pop hook。Tool 在 1990 年代音乐节与 RATM 共享政治 metal 听众。

Morello 的效果链独奏被广泛模仿；后来乐队多取吉他方法，少取口号本身。

Audioslave 是与 Soundgarden 主唱的共同项目。2010 年伦敦免费演出，对应 2009 年英国圣诞节冠军单曲。

note.en:
Morello FX as lead voice; de la Rocha political vocals.

The four do not change in the entry. The gap band is Audioslave: the same instrumental trio plus Cornell.
note.zh:
Morello 效果器作主声部；de la Rocha 政治人声。

条目里四人没有换过。空档期的乐队是 Audioslave：同一套乐器组加上 Cornell。

note.en: Build-to-shout structure; early protest-rock citation on US radio.
note.zh: 堆叠到怒吼的结构；美国电台早期抗议摇滚引用曲。

note.en: Rap-metal without a DJ; political lyric as the default subject.
note.zh: 无 DJ 的 rap-metal；政治歌词为默认题材。
